purpose: Fail-closed source-batch preflight before handoff to NF06. This contract does not redefine the internal NF06 schema; it proves that an immutable source export is eligible to be handed to NF06.
prod_requirements: server/reverse-proxy logging review reference is present
production research-only storage binding reference is present
source export SHA-256 matches the bytes actually parsed
every record has an opaque recruitment_channel_id declared in the frozen collection frame
all records validate against the frozen form definitions
all record timestamps fall inside the declared collection window
response_id values are unique within the batch
direct-identifier aliases and identifier-like free text are rejected again at pre-ingest
CRM linkage and commercial tracking remain FORBIDDEN
test_twin_requirements: test output is never eligible for PROD promotion

record_provenance.meaning: opaque first-party dissemination-batch identifier, never a respondent/device/CRM identifier

canonical_source_export: UTF-8 NDJSON, one canonical JSON record per line, sorted by form_id / received_at / response_id, newline terminated
manifest_privacy_boundary: The pre-ingest manifest contains counts, hashes, timestamps and opaque channel provenance only. It must not contain questionnaire answers, free-text responses, raw idempotency keys, IP addresses, user agents, cookies, referrer/UTM payloads, CRM identifiers or optional contact data.
promotion_rule: Only PROD_REAL_EVIDENCE batches that pass this contract may be offered to NF06. TEST_TWIN output is permanently NON_EVIDENCE.
